text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: *Slurp! Sluuuuurp!*

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
So good—!
It's delicious...!
Tasty. Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to come to this shop for the longest time!
Just as delicious as I'd hoped... No, it exceeded all my expectations!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My, oh my. Getting to taste local delicacies from all over—we truly have the 'Regional Racetrack Tour' to thank.
choice_data_list: The real race is right after this, so don't overeat, okay?
The real race is right after this, so try not to overeat, okay?

text_block_list.text:
As an escort, I gave a gentle warning just in case.
Today, I had visited Hakodate Racecourse as a chaperone for Fine Motion and the others.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"We are now accepting applicants
for our upcoming 'Regional Racecourse Tour'!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The purpose is for all of you who may race far away in the future
to get a feel for the local atmosphere,
so that you can make use of it when the real race comes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: At an unfamiliar racetrack, even subtle differences in the environment can be disorienting... I organized this project hoping to alleviate that, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We eagerly await
applications from all of you!

Experiencing the atmosphere of local racecourses...
That should prove beneficial for <chrname> as well.
With that in mind, we joined the other Umamusume in this project. Having stopped at Niigata Racecourse and Fukushima Racecourse, here at our third venue—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hakodate really is a wonderful place! And I found
another ramen shop that I totally love!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ When should I visit next?
I need to get my plane tickets ready.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Y-You plan on commuting? All the way to Hokkaido?
You really love ramen, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because to me, ramen—
is something that's worth that much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Could you call it a part of Fine Motion?
I just can't imagine myself without ramen anymore!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, what about you guys? Do you like ramen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It's not really a matter of likes or dislikes,
more like something I've just been used to since I was a kid, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...My mom runs a snack bar, you know.
Whenever I was hungry, she'd make me mini ramen.
I guess that's the flavor of home for me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ramen. I like it.
Plus, my name has a long vowel mark in it too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Thin, straight noodles are the best. They even have "straight" right there in the name.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "I-I love them too... But maybe because I love them so much, I try not to eat them too often."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...I only eat super spicy ramen on days
when I feel like I did my best.
It's like, a reward of sorts... Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I love ramen too! Because... look. Just look at that customer!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
*blow, blow*... *sluuuuurp*.
Phew...! Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I believe ramen possesses that kind of power—
the charm to bring a smile to anyone's face!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: With so many varieties of noodles and broths, anyone can find their own 'perfect bowl'...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Her broad-mindedness, or how she always lives up to
everyone's expectations... I think it's truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't wait for the race... Who do you think's
gonna win? Personally, I'm going with number 8!
She clocked a great time in her last race too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... or rather, that makes sense. It's a ramen shop
near Hakodate Racecourse, so a lot of the customers
are probably race fans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Everyone has such expectant looks on their faces.
It makes me excited too, somehow!
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head over to the racetrack soon?
Well then, should we head over to the racetrack soon?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Out of the turn, the Umamusume enter the final stretch!
Hakodate's stretch is the shortest of all JRA racetracks!
Can the chasers make it in time!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there... You can do it!!" "Go for it!"
"Close the gap!" "Don't give up!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Aaaaaaaaaaagh!
Reach themmmmmm!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats on the win!!!" "You're the best!!"
"Great run!" "You were so cool!"
"We're expecting big things from you!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! You're right...!
Tokyo Racecourse and the other Big Four venues
have way more spectators, yet..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The fervor remained unchanged. Here, too, were cheers
powerful enough to push an Umamusume forward.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was totally blown away...!

text_block_list.text: Indeed, the Umamusume who won earlier seemed to surge forward, bolstered by the crowd's cheers. That was just the kind of power this racecourse held.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just like Hakodate, the other racecourses were the same.
Surely, all the places we'll visit from now on will be too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Everything we do is made possible by our fans. If they continue to shower us with their unending cheers—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah!
Let's return the favor for all their cheers♪ Together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Repaying their cheers?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because right now, they are the ones supporting the prosperity of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――! You're right!
I want to return the favor too...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I'm feeling super pumped up!
Living up to everyone's expectations through my running goes without saying, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, anything!
Maybe I'd like to do something extra special!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If I truly want to repay the favor,
I felt I needed to go above and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Only by going that far can I truly say
I've repaid everyone for their support!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! If someone gives you something,
you have to return the favor! As an Umamusume, and as myself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Well said, you two. Exactly right.
We have to repay what we've received from our fans.
Otherwise, I just wouldn't feel right with myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nn... You're right. Everyone back home
and at the shopping district has taken care of me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...M-Me too! I... I'm not confident I can repay you with my running... so at the very least,
I want to repay you with other things!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Looks like the decision is made!
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Um. What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's host a Straight Festival. We'll do a straight haunted house, sell straight donuts, and form a band called "The Straights." I'm getting so excited!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't you left everything except individuality behind!?
Wouldn't only hardcore Right O fans
be happy with that?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! H-How about building a petting zoo
where you can interact with the animals~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! ...Ah, but if we do that, what about all the hard work the animals put in...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrmmm.
Hrrrrmmm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it like this, it really is difficult...
I want to do "something" that puts a smile on our fans' faces across the country, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Something to make them smile...

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
*blow, blow*... *sluuuuurp*.
Phew...! Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's right!
Hey, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: How about repaying your debt with ramen!?
